research_role: New retrospective extension; original final year already inspected.
question: Can frozen time-series foundation models improve the delayed 28-day pageview forecast over the eight-week weekday mean?

chronos2.point_forecast: native q0.5, after shared monotone projection and zero clipping

timesfm25.point_forecast: native q0.5, after shared monotone projection and zero clipping

input: One univariate sequence of raw counts; no title text, event features, related series or future observations.
context_length_selection: Fixed by design before model inference; no search or scored pilot.
quantile_postprocessing: Sort q0.1/q0.5/q0.9 within each target, then clip each at zero. Retain raw values and repair counts.
primary_point_metric: MAE of the same q0.5 point forecast for both models
intervals: Native q0.1 to q0.9 pointwise bands, no local residual calibration. Coverage, clipped width, interval score, directional misses and complete-path containment are descriptive.
sensitivity: Score the same predictions excluding November 2025 targets: 335 days, 12 contributing paths. Do not remove November context or refit.
failure_policy: Unexpected or nonfinite model outputs stop execution and retain a failure record; no baseline fallback or optimizer retries.

pretraining_audit.timesfm25: Official card identifies Wikimedia Pageviews through November 2023, GIFT-Eval Pretrain, Google Trends and synthetic data. Exact Buckethead membership and coverage of all corpus components are unverified. The first tuning path intersects the documented Wikimedia cutoff month.
pretraining_audit.chronos2: Technical report lists Wiki among real pretraining datasets. Exact Buckethead membership and last training date for every component are unverified.
pretraining_audit.interpretation: No task-specific fine-tuning does not prove previously unseen series or target dates. Shared older history is distinct from evaluated-target overlap. Scores are not certified contamination-free.
pretraining_audit.availability: Modern fixed-checkpoint backtest. Early historical origins precede checkpoint availability; no claim that these models could have been issued then.

prospective_confirmation: Not performed; no new data retrieval or future forecast issuance in this extension.
